traits.name: Flurry of Blows (2/Short Rest)
traits.text:
If the traveler has
attacked this turn, it can make an additional
unarmed strike as a bonus action.

traits.name: Shadow Arts (2/Short Rest)
traits.text: The traveler duplicates the effects of certain spells. As an action, it can cast darkness, darkvision, pass without trace, or silence without providing material components.

traits.name: Shadow Step
traits.text:
When the traveler is in dim light or
darkness, as a bonus action it can teleport up to 60
feet to an unoccupied space it can see that is also
in dim light and darkness. The traveler then has
advantage on the fight melee attack it makes before
the end of the turn.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.text:
While not wearing armor, the
traveler's AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The traveler makes three attacks, two
with its quarterstaff and one with its unarmed
strike.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach
5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning
damage.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit,
reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning
damage.
